title: Swipe Room daily judgements (written by the Claude step)
description: Cross-file rules that JSON Schema cannot express are checked by `python -m pipeline validate`: every idea_id in new_ideas.json appears exactly once (in one cluster or in spam), quality keys equal the cluster's idea_ids, cluster ids are new or reuse an open_clusters id, same_as_item names a recent_items id, video ids are known.

cluster_id.description: New kebab-case id, or an open_clusters id to add today's ideas to that cluster.

title.description: Imperative change, e.g. 'Open on the burger, not the logo'.

summary.description: What to change, where, and why it should help, in 1-3 sentences.

video_ids.description: Videos the change applies to; [] for channel-wide.

quality.description: idea_id -> 0..1, one entry per idea_id of this cluster.

conflicts.description: Which know-how rule(s) this clashes with and how, or null.

same_as_item.description: Optional: id of an already published batch item (recent_items) these ideas repeat; the cluster is not published again, its suggesters are credited with that item's verdict.

spam.description: idea_ids that are spam, abuse, gibberish or not an idea at all (quality counts as 0).

notes.description: Optional free text for the digest (patterns noticed, doubts).
